item.title: Circle names BlackRock, Visa, Mastercard, and DTCC among 11 founding validators for Arc institutional blockchain ahead of Sept. 16 mainnet.
Mastercard closes $1.8B acquisition of stablecoin infrastructure firm BVNK, adding $30B in annual settlement volume across 130 countries.
U.S. Senate files cloture on CLARITY Act before August recess, scheduling first procedural floor vote for September 15.
SEC launches tokenized-stock sandbox exemption and new crypto investment contract issuance mechanism for U.S. capital markets.
EU MiCA enforcement now active: CASPs without full authorization barred from onboarding new EU clients as of July 1 deadline.
Galaxy Research cuts CLARITY Act passage odds to 30% as Trump crypto ethics provision stalls bipartisan Senate agreement.
JPMorgan confirms institutional crypto spot trading now live, disclosed during the bank's most recent quarterly earnings call.
BlackRock to deploy BUIDL tokenized money-market fund on Circle's Arc blockchain ahead of September 16 institutional mainnet launch.
EU Transfer of Funds Regulation requires crypto service providers to collect sender and recipient identity data on all transfers, no threshold.
Coldcard hardware wallet firmware flaw linked to theft of at least $38M in bitcoin, one of the largest self-custody security failures on record.
Cross-chain bridge and DeFi protocols lose $35M in three coordinated exploits across a six-hour window.
Aave governance overhauls asset-listing standards following $230M rsETH bridge exploit that exposed cross-chain collateral custody risks.
JPMorgan, Citi, and Wells Fargo building tokenized settlement rails to connect on-chain assets to existing Wall Street clearing infrastructure.
